The middle of the club is taken up by a large dance floor, which is currently occupied by a huge crowd of revellers. It's from here that the bassy background music originates, and, looking up towards the ceiling, you see a series of arcane-powered loudspeakers, which are clearly responsible for blaring out the generic club music.

Suddenly, the lights go out. A thick mist rolls in, swirling around dance floor, while a screen begins lowering down from the ceiling, displaying a countdown. Instead of people panicking around you, they seem to get... excited? They're even taking out what seems to be glow sticks.

[beaten1.speech(Oh, is she here?!)] [beaten2.speech(Woah, what's happening?)] [beaten3.speech(SHE'S HERE SHE'S HERE SHE'S HERE-)]

The numbers tick down from ten, and the crowd joins in, their voices growing louder with each passing second. "FIVE! FOUR! THREE! TWO! ONE!"

With a deafening roar, the dance floor explodes in a burst of light and sound! A dazzling array of lasers shoots across the nightclub, while the beat of the opening track thunders through the speakers, shaking the very foundation of the building.

The screen now shows a silhouette, slowly descending from the ceiling on a floating platform adorned with shimmering lights. The figure's presence is electrifying, even before she reveals herself. The music builds, the bassline pulsating with energy as the silhouette draws nearer.

Finally, the platform touches down, and the stage lights up to reveal the idol in all her glory. Dressed in a sparkling[#(flags.hasFlag('xys_playerHasTransformed'))?', and rather familiar, ':' ']outfit that catches every beam of light, she strikes a pose, her face breaking into a confident smile. The crowd erupts, the sound of their cheers blending with the music to create a symphony of excitement.

[idol.speech(Hello everyone, and welcome back! Tonight, we're going to make memories that'll last forever! Let's make this a night we'll never forget! Are you READY!?)] she shouts, her voice clear and powerful as it echoes through the nightclub. The audience responds with a unified scream, their enthusiasm palpable.

With a wink and a playful laugh, she takes center stage, raising her microphone high. The beat drops, and the idol launches into her opening number, her voice soaring above the music. The stage erupts into a spectacle of light and movement, with dancers flanking her on either side. Every move is precise, every note pitch-perfect as she captivates the audience, drawing them deeper into her world.

[idol.speech( Fusagu me ni ochiru keshiki no you ni
Kasumu watashi wa dare no mono demo nai no
BUY ME
SO FEELING
Karakawanaide
Watashi dake ni misete
Ibitsu na yoru o douzo )]

The energy in the arena reaches a fever pitch, with the crowd dancing, singing, and waving their glow sticks in perfect harmony. The idol commands the stage, her presence larger than life as she leads her fans through an unforgettable opening show. Swept up by the excited energy in the air, you move along with the crowd, wildly cheering for the idol.

And as the first song reaches its climax, she strikes another powerful pose, letting the final note hang in the air. The audience goes crazy, the sound of their applause shaking the entire foundation of the building!

[idol.speech(Thank you, thank you everyone!)] she waves cheerfully at the excited fans. [idol.speech(There will be more coming up, so don't just leave yet! The night's still young, after all!)]

With that she steps off the stage, #IF(flags.hasFlag('xys_idol_intro_alleyways')) her eyes roaming around before landing on you, a look of surprise and recognition appearing on her face, #ELSE her eyes briefly landed on you, #ENDIF before mingling with the audience. Excitmement still lingering in the air, you turn to the person next to you, a [beaten1.raceFull(true)] with glowing runes painted on [beaten1.her] cheeks and a wide, knowing smile on [beaten1.her] face.

[beaten1.speech(Oh, you must be new! That was just the beginning, the grand entrance of our idol, [idol.name]! She appeared quite recently, but she has been making a name for herself in the redlight district for her songs!)] the [beaten1.race] says, [beaten1.her] eyes sparkling with enthusiasm. [beaten1.speech(Trust me, by the end of the night, you'll be completely enchanted!)]

You can see [idol.name] singing her heart out for her fans, dancing to the nightclub's music with a bright smile on her face.

#IF(idol.getAffection(pc) >= 40)

As if sensing you gaze, she turns to look at you. Her smile seems to get even sweeter as she gives you a small wave, before turning back towards the crowd with more vigor than before.

#ELSEIF(idol.getAffection(pc) < 40 && idol.getAffection(pc) > -40) #IF(flags.hasFlag('xys_idol_intro_alleyways'))

#ENDIF #ELSE

As if sensing you gaze, she turns to look at you. Her smile seems to dim slightly, before turning back towards the crowd without so much as acknowledging your existence.

#ENDIF

You wave towards [idol.name], catching her gaze, before gesturing that you'd like to join in on her performance.

#IF(!flags.hasFlag('xys_idol_dance_first_performance')) [##flags.setFlag('xys_idol_dance_first_performance', true)] #IF(pc.hasStatusEffect(SE_xys_set_magical_girl))

She is quite shocked to see you, not expecting someone to have the same outfit as hers to be in the crowd. Shaking herself out of her stupor, she gives a silent signal to someone unseen, before with a fluorish, she points at you, the lights following her target!

[beaten3.speech(A new challenger approaches?!)] [beaten1.speech(UWOOOOOH LET'S FUCKING GOOOOO!)] [beaten2.speech(Where do these people keep popping up...?)]

She sighs, a frown briefly appearing on her face before returning back to her smile. [idol.speech(Ladies and gentlemen, please welcome our beloved co-star of tonight, [#pc.getName().toUpperCase()]!)]

The audience goes wild as you step forward to the stage, the nightclub instantly abuzz with excitement and wonder! [#(pc.isShy()?'Giving everyone a shy little wave,':'Giving everyone a polite wave,')] you start to sing and dance with the idol.

#IF(flags.getSavedLong('idol_performance_count') > 10) [style.italicsGood(Now used to the routine, you can perfectly keep up with [idol.namePos] pace, making the crowd go crazy with excitement from the performance!)] [##flags.setSavedLong('idol_performance_multiplier', 5)] #ELSEIF(pc.getOccupation() == OCCUPATION_ATHLETE || pc.hasTraitActivated(PERK_MARTIAL_ARTIST) || pc.getAttributeValue(ATTRIBUTE_MAJOR_PHYSIQUE) >= 30.0) [style.italicsMinorGood(Despite not being used to singing, you make up for it with your dancing, easily moving along [idol.namePos] pace, bringing cheers and applause from the crowd!)] [##flags.setSavedLong('idol_performance_multiplier', 2)] #ELSEIF(pc.getOccupation() == OCCUPATION_MUSICIAN) [style.italicsMinorGood(Despite not being used to dancing, you make up for it with your singing, providing beautiful vocals in tune with [idol.namePos], bringing cheers and applause from the crowd!)] [##flags.setSavedLong('idol_performance_multiplier', 2)] #ELSEIF(flags.getSavedLong('idol_performance_count') > 5) [style.italicsMinorBad(Still not too familiar with the routine, you messes up the first few steps of the dance, making the audience laugh.)] But after that embarrassing moment, your steps become much smoother than before, able to somewhat keep up with [idol.namePos] pace. [##flags.setSavedLong('idol_performance_multiplier', 0)] #ENDIF

[#pc.incrementMoney(100 + (200 * flags.getSavedLong('idol_performance_multiplier')) + RND.nextInt(101))] [#idol.incrementAffection(pc, 10)] #IF(game.getHourOfDay() + 1 == 24) [##flags.setSavedLong('temp', 1)]

As you continue to dance into the night, you briefly see [idol.name] from the corners of your eye, moving away from the crowd and slipping into the backroom.

#IF(pc.hasTraitActivated(PERK_OBSERVANT))

It would be none of your concern, had you not also noticed that she's pretty flushed in the face and shaking slightly. #IF(flags.hasFlag('xys_idol_identity_discovered')) Remembering what happened last time, you can guess that she's going towards the back alley to "relieve" herself. You ponder if you should follow her... #ELSE Perhaps she needs to rest a bit before continue with her performance. #ENDIF

#ELSE

Since it's none of your concern, you continue to dance and mingle with the other clubbers, but you secretly wonder when she'll be back.

[##idol.setLust(100)]

You walk towards the idol, hearing heavy breathing along with suspiciously wet noises the closer you get to her. As you round the corner, you find yourself looking down on [idol.namePos] bewildered face, her fingers stuck mid-way through her [idol.pussy+].
